description: Product Search - Add search functionality to the shop frontend

userStories.title: Add search API endpoint
userStories.description: Create API endpoint to search products by name (EN/KH) and description
acceptanceCriteria: Accept query parameter 'q' for search term
Search in nameEn, nameKh, descriptionEn, descriptionKh fields
Return matching products with category info

userStories.title: Add search input component to shop header
userStories.description: Add a search input field in the shop header for customers to search products
acceptanceCriteria: Add search input to shop header (components/shop-header.tsx or similar)
Use Shadcn Input component with Search icon
Responsive: full width on mobile, fixed width on desktop
Placeholder text: 'Search products...' (EN) / 'ស្វែងរកផលិតផល...' (KH)
userStories.notes: Search input added to components/header.tsx with Shadcn Input + Search icon

userStories.title: Implement search results dropdown
userStories.description: Show search results in a dropdown as user types
acceptanceCriteria: Show dropdown with matching products below search input
Display product image, name, and price in results
Show 'No results found' message when no matches
userStories.notes: SearchDropdown component with 300ms debounce, skeleton loading, bilingual no results message

userStories.title: Add search result click navigation
userStories.description: Navigate to product detail page when clicking a search result
acceptanceCriteria: Click on search result navigates to /shop/product/[id]
Keyboard navigation: Enter to select highlighted result
userStories.notes: Click navigates to /shop/product/[id], keyboard nav with Arrow Up/Down and Enter, Escape to close

userStories.title: Add search to translations
userStories.description: Add bilingual support for search UI text
userStories.notes: Added search translations (placeholder, noResults, searching, viewAll) to lib/i18n.ts for EN/KH. Updated header.tsx and search-dropdown.tsx to use translations.

userStories.title: Add search API security features
userStories.description: Implement security measures for the search API endpoint
acceptanceCriteria: Add input validation: max query length (100 chars)
Sanitize search input to prevent XSS in results
userStories.notes: Implemented input validation (100 char max), XSS sanitization, in-memory rate limiting (60 req/min), 400 responses for invalid queries, suspicious pattern logging

userStories.title: Add whitelabel product filtering
userStories.description: Filter search results to only show active products visible to customers
acceptanceCriteria: Only return products where isActive = true
Only return products where isVisible = true (if field exists)
Filter by shopId/tenantId if multi-tenant (from settings)
Exclude out-of-stock products option via query param 'inStock=true'
userStories.notes: Implemented: isActive=true (already present), inStock=true param filters by inventory.quantity > 0, includes inventory data in response. Single-tenant system so no shopId filtering needed. isVisible field doesn't exist in schema.

userStories.title: Add search result branding support
userStories.description: Support whitelabel branding in search results display
acceptanceCriteria: Use shop's primary color for search highlight
Support custom 'no results' message from shop settings
Apply shop's font settings to search dropdown
userStories.notes: Implemented SearchBranding interface with primaryColor/accentColor/borderRadius/customNoResultsMessage. Keyboard-highlighted items use shop primary color. Dropdown inherits parent font via CSS cascade. Currency already respected via currency prop.

userStories.title: Add search analytics tracking
userStories.description: Track search queries for shop analytics and security monitoring
acceptanceCriteria: Log search queries to database (SearchLog model)
Add API endpoint GET /api/analytics/search for admin
Show popular searches in admin dashboard
userStories.notes: Implemented SearchLog model, logging in search API, analytics endpoint with popular/zero-result queries, and PopularSearchesWidget in dashboard

userStories.title: Dynamic component registry system
userStories.description: Create a registry for dynamic shop components that can be enabled/disabled per client
acceptanceCriteria: Create ComponentRegistry type with id, name, component, defaultEnabled fields
Support lazy loading components with React.lazy()
Add enable/disable toggle in admin settings
userStories.notes: Implemented ComponentRegistry with types, register/get functions, lazy loading support via registerLazyComponent, and admin toggle in Settings page

userStories.title: Dynamic page builder blocks
userStories.description: Add draggable content blocks for the shop page builder
acceptanceCriteria: Create block types: Hero, ProductGrid, Banner, Testimonials, Features, FAQ
Each block has configurable props (title, images, products, etc.)
Blocks can be reordered via drag-and-drop
userStories.notes: Added Testimonials (with ratings), Features (with icons), and FAQ (accordion) block types. Each has editor and renderer components with bilingual support. Drag-and-drop already supported via @dnd-kit.

userStories.title: Admin sales report dashboard
userStories.description: Create comprehensive sales reporting for admin dashboard
acceptanceCriteria: Create GET /api/reports/sales endpoint with date range filter
Add chart visualization (use Recharts or similar)
userStories.notes: Implemented /api/reports/sales with date range, totalRevenue/orderCount/averageOrderValue/topProducts, salesByCategory/salesByChannel/topCustomers. Updated reports-page.tsx with AreaChart, BarChart, LineChart, PieChart. CSV export via /api/export.

userStories.title: Admin customer analytics report
userStories.description: Track and display customer behavior analytics
acceptanceCriteria: Show customer growth chart over time
Display top customers by order value
userStories.notes: Implemented /api/reports/customers with summary (totalCustomers, newCustomers, returningCustomers, retentionRate, avgCustomerLifetimeValue), topCustomers by LTV, customerGrowthData (monthly), and customer segments (VIP, active, atRisk, churned, new). Added useCustomerReport hook and Customers tab in reports-page.tsx with retention rate ring, segments pie chart, growth area chart.

userStories.title: Admin inventory report
userStories.description: Inventory status and low stock alerts report
acceptanceCriteria: Configurable low stock threshold per product
userStories.notes: Implemented /api/reports/inventory with lowStockProducts (critical/low status), outOfStockProducts, totalInventoryValue (USD/KHR), stockByCategory, fastMovingProducts, slowMovingProducts. Configurable threshold via ?threshold= param. Added Inventory tab to reports-page.tsx with full visualizations.

userStories.title: Multi-tenant client model
userStories.description: Database schema and API support for multiple shop clients
acceptanceCriteria: Add Client model to Prisma: id, name, domain, settings, createdAt
Add clientId foreign key to Product, Order, Customer models
Middleware to inject clientId from domain/subdomain
userStories.notes: Implemented Client model with slug/domain support, clientId on Product/Order/Customer, /api/clients CRUD with super admin auth, and middleware for client detection from hostname

userStories.title: Client-specific theming
userStories.description: Each client can have custom theme colors and branding
acceptanceCriteria: Add theme fields to Client model: primaryColor, secondaryColor, logo, favicon
Create useClientTheme() hook to apply theme CSS variables
Theme applies to all shop pages automatically
Preview theme in admin before saving
userStories.notes: Added theme fields to Client model (primaryColor, secondaryColor, logoUrl, faviconUrl). Created useClientTheme/useClientThemeStyles hooks. Added /api/client/theme endpoint. Created ClientThemeEditor with live preview. Theme applies automatically via shop-app.tsx.

userStories.title: Client domain routing
userStories.description: Route requests to correct client based on domain/subdomain
acceptanceCriteria: Create middleware to detect client from request hostname
Store client context in request for API routes
Fallback to default client if domain not found
userStories.notes: Enhanced client-middleware.ts with parseClientSlugHeader for domain: prefix handling, robust fallback to default client when domain not found, getClientSlugFromHeaders helper, createDefaultClientContext function, and getClientFromRequestWithFallback for guaranteed client context. Middleware already handles subdomain/custom domain detection.

userStories.title: Recently viewed products
userStories.description: Track and display recently viewed products for better UX
acceptanceCriteria: Store recently viewed product IDs in localStorage (max 10)
Create RecentlyViewed component showing product cards
Display on product detail page and homepage
userStories.notes: Implemented useRecentlyViewed hook with localStorage (max 10 items), RecentlyViewed component with grid display, integrated into product detail page with auto-tracking, clear button in UI, bilingual support (EN/KH)

userStories.title: Product recommendations
userStories.description: Show related products based on category and purchase history
acceptanceCriteria: Return products from same category, excluding current product
Optional: Use order history for 'customers also bought' logic
userStories.notes: Implemented /api/products/[id]/recommendations with 'customers also bought' logic using order history and same-category fallback. Created ProductRecommendations component with skeleton loading, bilingual support, 'Popular' badge for frequently co-purchased products. Integrated into product detail page.

userStories.title: Wishlist functionality
userStories.description: Allow customers to save products to a wishlist
acceptanceCriteria: Add Wishlist model: id, customerId, productId, createdAt
Add heart icon button on product cards
Create wishlist page showing saved products
Persist in localStorage for guests, database for logged-in users
userStories.notes: Implemented Wishlist model with guestId support, GET/POST/DELETE /api/wishlist endpoint, useWishlist hook with localStorage + API sync, WishlistButton component on product cards (product-grid.tsx, products-section.tsx), wishlist page at /shop/wishlist with WishlistContent component, bilingual translations (EN/KH)

userStories.title: Product quick view modal
userStories.description: Quick view popup without navigating to product page
acceptanceCriteria: Show product image, name, price, description, add to cart button
Open via 'Quick View' button on product card hover
userStories.notes: Implemented ProductQuickView with image gallery (thumbnails + arrows), QuickViewButton on product card hover, quantity selector, bilingual support (EN/KH), stock status display. Integrated into product-grid.tsx and products-section.tsx.

userStories.title: Advanced product filtering
userStories.description: Filter products by price range, category, and attributes
acceptanceCriteria: Create FilterSidebar component with collapsible sections
Sort options: price low-high, high-low, newest, popular
URL query params sync for shareable filtered views
userStories.notes: Implemented FilterSidebar with collapsible sections, price range slider, category checkboxes, sort options (6 options), in-stock filter, URL query params sync. Created /shop/products page. Added Shadcn slider, checkbox, collapsible components. Bilingual support (EN/KH).

userStories.title: Product reviews and ratings
userStories.description: Customer reviews with star ratings for products
acceptanceCriteria: Add Review model: id, productId, customerId, rating (1-5), comment, createdAt
Display average rating on product cards
Show review list on product detail page
userStories.notes: Implemented Review model with status (PENDING/APPROVED/REJECTED), POST/GET /api/products/[id]/reviews endpoint, StarRating component on product cards and detail page, ProductReviews component with submit form/pagination, admin ReviewsPage with approve/reject/delete moderation, reviews nav in sidebar with pending badge.

userStories.title: Order status notifications
userStories.description: Notify customers of order status changes
acceptanceCriteria: Create notification service for order updates
Support email notifications (optional, if SMTP configured)
userStories.notes: Implemented NotificationPreference/NotificationLog models, notification service with Telegram/Email support, /api/notifications/preferences endpoint, auto-trigger on order status change, NotificationPreferences UI in customer profile with Tabs

userStories.title: Admin dashboard widgets
userStories.description: Customizable dashboard with draggable widget cards
acceptanceCriteria: Create widget types: SalesOverview, RecentOrders, LowStock, TopProducts
Save widget layout preference per admin user
userStories.notes: Implemented DashboardWidgets component with SalesOverview, RecentOrders, LowStock, TopProducts widgets. Drag-and-drop reordering via @dnd-kit, layout persistence to settings API, 5-minute auto-refresh, customize dialog.

userStories.title: Bulk product import/export
userStories.description: Import and export products via CSV/Excel files
acceptanceCriteria: Support fields: name, price, stock, category, description, images
Validation with error report for failed rows
userStories.notes: Implemented /api/products/export (GET, CSV download) and /api/products/import (POST, multipart CSV upload) with dry-run validation, row-by-row error reporting, updateExisting option. ProductImportDialog with progress stages, ProductExportButton with filters. Added Alert and ScrollArea UI components.

userStories.title: Super admin client management
userStories.description: Super admin panel to manage all clients/tenants
acceptanceCriteria: List all clients with search and pagination
View client statistics: orders, revenue, products count
userStories.notes: Implemented SuperAdminPage with client list (search/pagination), create/edit/disable client dialogs, client stats API (/api/clients/[id]/stats), view dialog with revenue/orders/products/customers stats, impersonate feature via localStorage

userStories.title: Client subscription/billing model
userStories.description: Subscription tiers for multi-tenant SaaS billing
acceptanceCriteria: Add Subscription model: clientId, plan (free/starter/pro), status, expiresAt
Define plan limits: products, orders/month, features
Create GET /api/subscription endpoint for current plan
Show upgrade prompts when approaching limits
userStories.notes: Implemented Subscription model with FREE/STARTER/PRO plans, GET/POST/DELETE /api/subscription endpoint, plan limits (products/orders/customers/features), pricing config, SubscriptionUsageCard with usage bars and upgrade prompts, bilingual translations

userStories.title: Audit log for admin actions
userStories.description: Track all admin actions for security and compliance
acceptanceCriteria: Add AuditLog model: userId, action, resource, details, timestamp, ipAddress
Display audit log in admin settings page
Filter by date range, user, action type
userStories.notes: Implemented AuditLog model with AuditAction enum, audit-service.ts for logging helpers, GET /api/audit-logs with filtering/pagination/summary stats, AuditLogsPage with charts and detail dialog, integrated in sidebar and admin dashboard

userStories.title: PWA offline support
userStories.description: Progressive Web App features for offline access
acceptanceCriteria: Add manifest.json with app icons and theme color
Create service worker for caching static assets
Add to Home Screen prompt on mobile
userStories.notes: Implemented manifest.ts with SVG icons, service worker (sw.js) with caching strategies, offline page with cached products, PWA install prompt component, update banner, and offline indicator. Bilingual support (EN/KH).

userStories.title: JWT token authentication
userStories.description: Replace session-based auth with JWT tokens for better scalability
acceptanceCriteria: Generate JWT access token (15min expiry) and refresh token (7 days)
Store refresh token in httpOnly cookie
Add JWT verification middleware for protected routes
Include user role and permissions in token payload
userStories.notes: Implemented generateTokenPair (access 15m + refresh 7d), refresh-token httpOnly cookie, POST /api/auth/refresh endpoint with token rotation, verifyAccessToken/verifyRefreshToken in lib/jwt.ts, withAuth middleware supports both Bearer token and legacy cookie, AccessTokenPayload includes role and permissions

userStories.title: Role-based access control (RBAC)
userStories.description: Granular permissions system for admin users
acceptanceCriteria: Define roles: super_admin, admin, manager, staff
Create Permission model: id, name, description
Add middleware to check permissions on API routes
Create admin UI to manage role permissions
userStories.notes: Implemented Permission/RolePermission models in Prisma, lib/rbac.ts with 4 system roles and 42 granular permissions across 15 resources, requireResourcePermission/requireRole/requireSuperAdmin middleware, /api/permissions and enhanced /api/roles endpoints, RolePermissionsPage admin UI with permission matrix editor and role seeding

userStories.title: Two-factor authentication (2FA)
userStories.description: Optional 2FA for admin accounts using TOTP
acceptanceCriteria: Add twoFactorSecret and twoFactorEnabled to User model
Create POST /api/auth/2fa/setup endpoint returning QR code
Prompt for 2FA code on login if enabled
userStories.notes: Implemented 2FA with TOTP using otplib. Added twoFactorEnabled/twoFactorSecret/recoveryCodes to User model. Created /api/auth/2fa/setup (POST/PUT/DELETE), /api/auth/2fa/verify, /api/auth/2fa/disable, /api/auth/2fa/recovery-codes, /api/auth/2fa/status endpoints. Login returns pendingToken when 2FA enabled. TwoFactorSettings UI component with QR code setup wizard. Encrypted secret storage and hashed recovery codes.

userStories.title: Password security enhancements
userStories.description: Stronger password policies and secure handling
acceptanceCriteria: Minimum 8 chars, require uppercase, lowercase, number, special char
Use bcrypt with cost factor 12 for hashing
Prevent reuse of last 5 passwords (store password history)
Real-time password strength indicator on forms
userStories.notes: Implemented lib/password-security.ts with OWASP password practices. PasswordHistory model for reuse prevention, 90-day expiry warning, PasswordStrengthIndicator component with real-time feedback, bcrypt cost factor 12.

userStories.title: Account lockout protection
userStories.description: Prevent brute force attacks with account lockout
acceptanceCriteria: Lock account after 5 failed login attempts
Track failed attempts with IP address
userStories.notes: Implemented LoginAttempt/AccountLockout models, lib/account-lockout.ts service with configurable LOCKOUT_CONFIG, login API integration with failed/successful attempt tracking, email notification on lockout, GET/POST /api/admin/lockouts for admin management with audit logging

userStories.title: Session management
userStories.description: Track and manage active user sessions
acceptanceCriteria: Add Session model: userId, token, device, ipAddress, lastActive, createdAt
Show active sessions in user profile
Allow user to revoke individual sessions
userStories.notes: Implemented Session model with device/IP/UA/lastActive/isRevoked fields, lib/session-service.ts with CRUD operations, GET/DELETE /api/sessions endpoints, ActiveSessions UI component, integrated with login/2FA flows, 30-day auto-expiry via validateSession check

userStories.title: Security headers middleware
userStories.description: Add security headers to all responses
userStories.notes: Implemented all security headers in middleware.ts: CSP with script/style/img/connect directives, X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff, X-Frame-Options: DENY, HSTS with 1yr max-age (production only), X-XSS-Protection: 1; mode=block, Permissions-Policy for camera/geolocation/payment/fullscreen, Referrer-Policy: strict-origin-when-cross-origin, X-DNS-Prefetch-Control: on. Also created lib/security-headers.ts for reusable exports.

userStories.title: CSRF protection
userStories.description: Cross-Site Request Forgery protection for forms
acceptanceCriteria: Include token in all state-changing forms
userStories.notes: Implemented lib/csrf.ts with HMAC-signed tokens tied to session, GET /api/csrf endpoint, withCSRF/withAuthAndCSRF middleware, auto-refresh when <15min remaining, useCSRF React hook with createCSRFFetch wrapper, bilingual translations (EN/KH)

userStories.title: API key authentication
acceptanceCriteria: Add ApiKey model: id, clientId, key (hashed), name, scopes, expiresAt
Create POST /api/keys endpoint to generate keys
userStories.notes: Implemented ApiKey/ApiKeyUsageLog models, lib/api-key.ts with key generation/validation/rate limiting, POST/GET/PUT/DELETE /api/keys endpoint, withApiKey middleware with scope checking, 12 scopes across 8 resources, key rotation with 24h grace period, rate limit headers

userStories.title: OAuth2 social login
userStories.description: Login with Google and Facebook for customers
acceptanceCriteria: Link social accounts to existing email accounts
Create account if email doesn't exist
Store provider tokens for future use
userStories.notes: Implemented SocialAccount model, lib/oauth.ts config, lib/oauth-service.ts for account linking/creation, Google/Facebook OAuth endpoints with state verification, social-accounts API for management, encrypted token storage (AES-256-GCM), React hooks for frontend integration

userStories.title: Password reset flow
acceptanceCriteria: Rate limit reset requests (3 per hour per email)
userStories.notes: Implemented PasswordResetToken model, lib/password-reset.ts service with 60-min token expiry and rate limiting (3/hour), POST /api/auth/forgot-password and POST/GET /api/auth/reset-password endpoints, email notifications via notification-service, password history check, session revocation on reset, bilingual translations (EN/KH)

userStories.title: Email verification
acceptanceCriteria: Add emailVerified and emailVerifyToken to User/Customer model
Restrict certain actions until email verified
userStories.notes: Implemented EmailVerifyToken model, lib/email-verification.ts service with 24-hour token expiry and rate limiting (3/hour), POST /api/auth/send-verification and GET/POST /api/auth/verify-email endpoints, resend option with cooldown, isEmailVerificationRequired() helper for action restrictions, bilingual translations (EN/KH)

userStories.title: Login activity notifications
userStories.description: Alert users of new login activity
acceptanceCriteria: Send email on login from new device/location
Include device info, IP, location, timestamp
Option to mark as 'not me' to trigger security review
userStories.notes: Implemented LoginActivity model, lib/login-activity.ts service with device/location detection, GET/POST /api/auth/login-activity for user activity management and 'not me' reports, /api/admin/security/suspicious-logins for admin review, loginNotificationsEnabled user preference, integrated into login and 2FA verify flows, bilingual translations (EN/KH)

userStories.title: IP whitelisting for admin
userStories.description: Restrict admin access to specific IP addresses
acceptanceCriteria: Add allowedIPs field to User model (for admins)
Middleware to check IP on admin routes
Support CIDR notation for IP ranges
Super admin can bypass IP restrictions
userStories.notes: Implemented allowedIPs JSON field on User model, lib/ip-whitelist.ts with CIDR support (IPv4), withIPWhitelist/withAuthAndIPWhitelist/withAuthIPWhitelistAndCSRF middleware, super admin bypass via isSuperAdmin check, blocked access logging to audit_logs table, /api/admin/ip-whitelist endpoint for CRUD operations

userStories.title: Security event logging
acceptanceCriteria: Add SecurityLog model: event, userId, ipAddress, userAgent, details, timestamp
Log: logins, failed logins, password changes, 2FA events, permission changes
userStories.notes: Implemented SecurityLog model with SecurityEventType (40+ events) and SecurityEventSeverity (INFO/WARNING/CRITICAL) enums. Created lib/security-log.ts with helper functions, 90-day retention via expiresAt, suspicious pattern detection. GET /api/security-logs endpoint with filtering, pagination, stats. Integrated into login, logout, 2FA, password reset, session management flows.

userStories.title: Data encryption at rest
acceptanceCriteria: Encrypt PII fields: phone, address, payment details
Use AES-256 encryption with key from env variable
userStories.notes: Implemented lib/encryption.ts with AES-256-GCM encryption (IV + authTag), Prisma middleware in lib/prisma.ts for transparent encryption/decryption of Customer (phone, email, notes) and Payment (transactionId) fields. Key rotation via POST /api/admin/encryption with reEncrypt capability. ENCRYPTION_KEY env var required (32+ chars), ENCRYPTION_KEY_PREVIOUS for rotation.

userStories.title: API rate limiting
userStories.description: Global rate limiting for all API endpoints
acceptanceCriteria: Default limit: 100 requests per minute per IP
Return 429 with Retry-After header when exceeded
Redis-based rate limiting for distributed deployments
userStories.notes: Implemented lib/rate-limiter.ts with in-memory store (Redis-ready architecture), configurable endpoint limits, user-type rate limits (anonymous: 100/min, authenticated: 200/min, admin: 500/min, super_admin: 1000/min), withRateLimit middleware in auth-middleware.ts, 429 response with Retry-After and X-RateLimit-* headers

userStories.title: Input validation middleware
acceptanceCriteria: Create validation schemas for all API endpoints
Validate request body, query params, and path params
Sanitize string inputs to prevent XSS
Type-safe validated data in route handlers
userStories.notes: Implemented lib/validation.ts with withBodyValidation/withQueryValidation/withParamsValidation middleware, XSS sanitization (sanitizeString, containsXSS, sanitizeObject), common schemas (pagination, search, dateRange, sort), safe string types (safeEmail, safeUrl, safePhone), detailed 400 error responses with field-level details

userStories.title: Secure file upload
acceptanceCriteria: Validate file type by magic bytes (not just extension)
Max file size limit (5MB default, configurable)
Store files with random UUID names
Serve files through signed URLs with expiry
userStories.notes: Implemented lib/secure-upload.ts with magic byte validation (JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF, AVIF, SVG, PDF), type-specific max sizes, UUID filename generation, HMAC-signed URLs with expiry, SVG XSS validation, ClamAV placeholder. Enhanced /api/upload with comprehensive validation, added /api/uploads/signed-url and /api/uploads/signed-url/verify endpoints.

userStories.title: Admin security dashboard
acceptanceCriteria: Quick actions: force logout, lock account
userStories.notes: Implemented SecurityDashboardPage with security score, login activity (success/failed), active sessions by device, failed login trends chart, security alerts, locked accounts with unlock action, suspicious logins with force logout, critical events log. API at /api/admin/security-dashboard with timeframe filter (1h/6h/24h/7d/30d).

userStories.title: Multiple payment gateways
userStories.description: Support various payment methods for Cambodian market
acceptanceCriteria: Integrate ABA PayWay (most popular in Cambodia)
Cash on Delivery option with order confirmation
userStories.notes: Implemented lib/payment-gateways.ts with PaymentGatewayType (CASH/ABA_PAYWAY/WING/KHQR), unified /api/payments/gateway endpoint for all methods, /api/payments/verify for status checks, checkout-page.tsx with RadioGroup payment method selection, QR code display for KHQR, redirect support for ABA/Wing, COD confirmation flow, bilingual translations (EN/KH)

userStories.title: Checkout optimization
userStories.description: Streamlined checkout experience to reduce cart abandonment
acceptanceCriteria: One-page checkout with all steps visible
Save shipping address for returning customers
Order summary sidebar with easy quantity edit
Express checkout for saved payment methods
userStories.notes: Implemented one-page checkout with 3 sections (contact/address/payment), ShippingAddress model with guestId support, phone-based address lookup, quantity edit in order summary sidebar, express checkout via saved/default address selection

userStories.title: Coupon and discount system
acceptanceCriteria: Add Coupon model: code, type (percent/fixed), value, minOrder, maxUses, expiresAt
Apply coupon at checkout with validation
Support: percentage off, fixed amount, free shipping, BOGO
userStories.notes: Implemented Coupon/CouponUsage models, CRUD /api/coupons endpoint, /api/coupons/apply for validation and discount calculation, /api/coupons/use for tracking. CouponInput component with bilingual support integrated at checkout. Supports PERCENTAGE, FIXED_AMOUNT, FREE_SHIPPING, BOGO coupon types with min order, max discount, usage limits.

userStories.title: Flash sales and time-limited deals
acceptanceCriteria: Add FlashSale model: productId, salePrice, startTime, endTime, quantity
Countdown timer on product cards and detail page
Homepage banner for active flash sales
Admin calendar view for scheduling sales
userStories.notes: Implemented FlashSale model with SCHEDULED/ACTIVE/ENDED/CANCELLED status, CRUD /api/flash-sales endpoint, FlashSaleCountdown/Badge/Price components, FlashSaleBanner for homepage, FlashSalesPage admin with list/calendar views, product-grid integration with flash sale pricing

userStories.title: Customer loyalty program
acceptanceCriteria: Add LoyaltyPoints model: customerId, points, transactions
Earn points on purchases (1 point per $1)
Redeem points for discounts at checkout
Loyalty tiers: Bronze, Silver, Gold with multipliers
userStories.notes: Implemented LoyaltyAccount/LoyaltyTransaction models, 4 tiers (Bronze/Silver/Gold/Platinum), /api/loyalty endpoint, LoyaltyPointsCard and CheckoutLoyalty components, bilingual translations

userStories.title: Email marketing integration
acceptanceCriteria: Order confirmation and shipping notification emails
Welcome email series for new customers
userStories.notes: Implemented NewsletterSubscriber/EmailCampaign/EmailSend/AbandonedCart/WelcomeEmailProgress models, SendGrid/SMTP integration, newsletter form, abandoned cart recovery (1hr/24hr/72hr), order confirmation/shipping emails, welcome series, cron endpoint, bilingual translations

userStories.title: SEO optimization
userStories.description: Search engine optimization for better visibility
acceptanceCriteria: Dynamic meta tags (title, description, OG) per page
userStories.notes: Implemented generateMetadata() for product pages with title/description/OG/Twitter cards, sitemap.xml auto-generation with products/categories/static pages, JSON-LD schemas (Product/Breadcrumb/Organization/Website/LocalBusiness), canonical URLs via alternates.canonical, SEO-friendly slug support with ID fallback, lib/seo.ts utilities

userStories.title: Image optimization pipeline
acceptanceCriteria: Auto-resize uploaded images to multiple sizes
Convert to WebP format with fallback
userStories.notes: Implemented lib/image-optimizer.ts with sharp for multi-size generation (thumbnail/small/medium/large/xlarge), WebP conversion with JPEG/PNG fallback, blur placeholder (LQIP) generation. POST /api/images/optimize endpoint for optimized uploads. OptimizedImage component with lazy loading (Intersection Observer + native), blur-to-clear transition, picture element for WebP fallback, responsive srcset. CDN delivery via Cloudflare R2 with 1-year cache.

userStories.title: Performance monitoring
userStories.notes: Implemented PerformanceMetric and ErrorLog Prisma models, lib/performance.ts service with Web Vital thresholds, POST/GET/PATCH /api/performance endpoints, WebVitalsReporter component for client-side metrics (uses web-vitals package), performance hooks in api-hooks.ts, PerformancePage admin dashboard with Overview/Web Vitals/API/Database/Errors tabs, and sidebar nav item

userStories.title: Live chat support
acceptanceCriteria: Offline message form when no agents online
userStories.notes: Implemented ChatSession/ChatMessage/CannedResponse/AgentStatus Prisma models, chat API endpoints (sessions, messages, agent-status, canned-responses), ChatWidget component for shop pages with offline form, ChatPage admin dashboard with canned responses management, sidebar nav item, i18n translations for EN/KH

userStories.title: Help center and FAQ
acceptanceCriteria: Create HelpArticle model: title, content, category, views
Article view tracking for popular topics

userStories.title: Shipping zone configuration
